notes.mask_dimensions: In practice there is never any difference between image and mask dimension with the flatbug models.
notes.classes: Since the flatbug models do not try to do classification, the values in classification is actually just all ones (1).
notes.numbers: Class IDs and image/mask dimensions are integers. Coordinates, confidence, scales and areas are floating-point values.
notes.contours: Each contour is [x_coordinates, y_coordinates], with equal-length arrays. Author json_data derives contours in original-image coordinates, including the non-polygon mask path.
notes.identifier: json_data uses null; the flat-bug 1.2.0 CLI probe emitted a list containing a run UUID. This is not a unique image ID.
notes.boxes: [x1,y1,x2,y2] in original-image pixels with top-left origin.
notes.areas: Polygon-mode areas are in image pixel-square units. In the non-polygon path, areas count mask-grid pixels; differing mask dimensions require keeping that distinction.
